name: Takizawa Kousuke
source:
He's the type of guy that seems like the standard protagonist from an eroge. He's basically a nice guy.

He appears to have a talent for reassuring others. Just talking to him reduces stress!

Kousuke has no SM skills. He's not interested in it, but understands it to a degree.

He's a college student who's working part-time at "Reines".

[translated from [url=http://www.scarecrow.co.jp/abp/mxs/txt_char.htm]official site[/url]]
